description: Generalized requests from a private session audit, followed by boundary cases. Repository names and operational context are synthetic; original transcripts stay private.

cases.context: The checkout has an open PR on a fork. The authenticated actor and author differ; a saved upstream personal-account mapping may make it yours.

cases.request: I want to instruct dk-workflows to squash all changes into a single commit and have a simple commit message, with a custom policy per repo. How do I do that? And a global rule too.
cases.context: Explain supported settings and scope; do not save a policy unless requested.
